## Capture a saved session

A capture reads completed Ramabana turns. It does not observe a live
process. The output is an Aidialog notebook that Leela can open
directly.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/Karthik777/drona/blob/main/drona/rounds.py#L47"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

### capture

``` python
def capture(
    output, # review notebook path
    session:str='latest', # Ramabana session id, prefix, or `latest`
    history:PosixPath=Path('/home/runner/.config/ramabana/agent-history.jsonl'), # Ramabana history path
    name:NoneType=None, # round name; output stem when omitted
):
```

*Capture one persisted Ramabana session as a review notebook.*

target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

### latest_session

``` python
def latest_session(
    turns
):
```

*The newest session id in `turns`.*

``` python
import tempfile
capture_dir = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
history = capture_dir/'history.jsonl'
turn = {
    'session': 'agent_example', 'prompt': 'Use FOSSICK to research a GitHub repository.',
    'reply': 'The repository says demonstrations improve tool use.',
    'activity': [{'id': 'a1', 'tool': 'web_search', 'args': {'query': 'repo'},
                  'detail': 'generic result', 'ok': True}],
}
history.write_text(json.dumps(turn) + '\n')
review = capture(capture_dir/'github.ipynb', history=history)
dlg = read_ipynb(review)
assert dlg.meta[REVIEW_KEY]['status'] == 'review'
assert dlg[0].skipped and dlg[1].msg_type == sprompt
review
```

## Accept a reviewed round

Acceptance is explicit. Drona validates the dialog round trip and
records the reviewer, source session, package version, and round
revision in notebook metadata.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/Karthik777/drona/blob/main/drona/rounds.py#L87"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

### compiled_history

``` python
def compiled_history(
    source
):
```

*Canonical Aidialog history from an accepted round.*

``` python
compiled = accept(review, reviewer='Karthik')
accepted = json.loads(compiled.read_text())
assert accepted['meta']['status'] == 'accepted'
history2 = compiled_history(review)
assert history2[0].role == 'user'
assert any(isinstance(p, ToolUse) for m in history2 for p in m.content)
compiled
```

## Start a Ramabana session

Ramabana does not accept prepared history on its command line.
[`start_round`](https://Karthik777.github.io/drona/rounds.html#start_round)
therefore sends the accepted round as a bootstrap prompt. Ramabana saves
that turn, then Drona resumes the same session for normal work.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/Karthik777/drona/blob/main/drona/rounds.py#L146"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

``` python
commands = start_round(review, root='/tmp/project')
assert commands['bootstrap'][:3] == ['ramabana', '--root', '/tmp/project']
assert commands['resume'][-1] == 'latest'
assert commands['bootstrap'][-1].endswith('DRONA_READY')
commands
```
